title: Learn French with French Podcasts - Français avec Pierre
author: Pierre - Français avec Pierre
description: Learn French listening to French podcasts made by French teacher Pierre. You can often have the podcast transcripts in the BLOG http://francaisavecpierre.com . Whenever there is a transcript available, I will put the blog post URL in the podcast episode description, please check it out. You can learn and improve your French listening to the podcasts with lots of interesting topics, French lessons and a lot more. Learn French the fun and easy way!

extraits.texte: Moro na França faz um ano, tentei o Delf três vezes e nunca conseguia um bom resultado, após conhecer o curso Français avec Pierre, conseguir melhor muito meu francês. Todos meus amigos ficaram impressionados com isso.…

Ce podcast est vraiment génial pour apprendre le français au quotidien ! Pierre explique tout très clairement, avec beaucoup de bonne humeur. Merci pour ce contenu si utile, j’attends déjà le prochain épisode avec impatience. 😊🇰🇷🇫🇷
Excellent podcast for those who want to speak like natives: fun, interesting, short and varied! On top I learnt a few things on multiple topics! Great effort and work, keep it up!!
